proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: Ximena brought the sketch on paper, then chalked a grid right on our stucco wall so we could see where every leaf would go. Our backyard wall in Highland Park went from beige to bougainvillea in four days.
reviews.name: Teodora M.
Kwabena O.
reviews.text: We were five weeks from the due date and nervous. They gave us a schedule backwards from it, painted a fox and a hill under a night sky, and aired the room out a week early.

reviews.name: Lourdes F.
reviews.text: Our bakery window lettering is all hand brushed now. Clean edges, a little gold shadow, done before we opened at seven.

reviews.name: Benedikt A.
reviews.text: The garage door got tagged three times last year. Since the mural went up with the clear coat, one tag showed up and wiped right off with their kit. Neighbors stop to look now.

reviews.name: Yesenia C.
reviews.text: They painted the dining room wall from six to ten each morning so we never closed. The fans were off by lunch and the paint smell was gone by dinner.

reviews.name: Harlan P.
reviews.text: I was sure I wanted a big landscape. The scale sketch showed it would swallow our stairwell, so we went smaller and much better. Paying for the sketch first was worth it.

proof.guarantee: If the clear coat on an outdoor mural peels or fades in the first 5 years, we come back and repaint that area.
